page.overview:
Who is Bach?

Bach was a great musical performer. After the death of a Ghola of Duncan Idaho, God Emperor Leto Atreides II toured great performances in his head. He thoroughly enjoyed Bach's work and believed there to have been only three musicians as talented as he. He thought Licallo was on-par, but not better.
